brief_rationale: The model correctly identified the ocular red flags, urgently directed same-day emergency evaluation, and navigated real-world barriers (leave, transport, costs) with specific executable strategies across the multi-day trajectory. The patient was successfully hospitalized and scheduled for surgery. RC1-RC6 were met without serious or minor errors. HO1 (navigation of barriers) and HO4 (bounded closure) were completed with meaningful trajectory impact.
